data.one_liner: A customizable step indicator widget for horizontal or vertical layouts.
data.what_it_does: Displays a series of steps with optional titles, subtitles, counters, and connecting lines. Supports tap navigation and programmatic control via a controller.
use_when: Building onboarding flows or multi-step forms
Need a visual progress indicator with custom styling
Want tap-to-navigate or programmatic step control
avoid_when: You need a fully featured wizard with validation logic
You require complex state management beyond simple step indices
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations
weaknesses: Limited to step display; no form validation or data handling
No built‑in persistence or state restoration
No unit tests for UI behavior in this snippet
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package
